newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Assets of former Bamerindus owners frozen.
newsitem.headline: Assets of former Bamerindus owners frozen.

text.p: The assets of the former owners of Brazilian private bank Bamerindus will be frozen following an intervention by the Central Bank.
In a statement, the Central Bank said the seizure of the assets was required by law.
Earlier Wednesday, the Central Bank said it had agreed to a proposal from Hong Kong & Shanghai Banking Corp that it take over Bamerindus with a $1.0 billion capital injection.
A solution for troubled Bamerindus had been on delayed for months on the insistence of controlling shareholder Jose Eduardo Andrade Vieira, a powerful senator, that he remain in charge.
It was not immediately clear if Andrade Vieira had agreed to the HSBC deal.
"One would think he had had more than enough time to find a solution himself," a senior Finance Ministry official said, asking not to be identified.
